source.title: Duskwood Mission XII: Dream-Touched Dragonscale
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Dream-Touched Dragonscales from dragonkin within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a skinner.
source.objective: Gather 10 Dream-Touched Dragonscales in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
